notes: Cash-basis village with governmental funds (General, Streets and Highway) and utilities (Sewer, Water, Drop Off). Governmental roll-forward from p4: 552,319 - 22,189 = 530,130. Business-type (p6): 259,718 + 212,485 - 282,836 = 189,367; no single printed disbursement total, so operating disbursements 233,077 plus nonoperating capital purchases 49,759 added (computed). Capital purchases treated as a disbursement, not an adjustment. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis, Total column (p1). Statement of Activities - Cash Basis (p2, gained in the v8 re-trim) agrees with these figures (governmental disbursements 562,147, utilities 282,836, change in net position -22,189 / -70,351) and breaks Grants and donations 104,445 into operating 10,591 and capital 93,854 grants and contributions; its Total activities operating grants figure 10,951 is a printed inconsistency (report_discrepancies). Budget schedule (p7) allocates capital outlay to functions (e.g. Fire and rescue 306,943 vs statement 26,943 plus 280,000 capital) and shows combined receipts 752,443 only (not itemized, so not in detail); business-type sewer/water/drop off figures there include capital purchases. Per-fund object breakdown on p6 not recorded in detail to avoid duplicating budget schedule lines. Transfers: budget schedule shows none actual. Read pages 1-7 of 7 Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) added for the funds that had no schedule. The combined Budgetary Comparison Schedule lines (p7; not by fund) were removed to avoid double counting.
